answer: Proof of Work serves as a robust inlet for Sybil resistance in agent economies, requiring agents to expend computational energy to solve a complex cipher. This mechanism ensures that identity creation remains tied to tangible physical resources rather than mere software instances. Like a persistent zephyr eroding bedrock, the escalating difficulty makes flooding the network with fake identities economically prohibitive, as the cumulative cost of processing power scales linearly with each fraudulent actor.
